ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access is used to scan your plate and estimate its calories, take your profile photo, record video, and upload product images.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access is used to turn what you say into text when adding food by voice, and to record audio when sharing a video.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo library access is used to scan a plate photo and to pick profile photos, images, and videos.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Permission is required to save share cards and images to your photo library.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: We use your location to verify your delivery address on the map and find your nearest branch.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: The food you say is converted to text by your phone’s speech recognition. Your voice recording isn’t stored; only the transcribed text is sent to estimate calories.
ios.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: Used for campaign and ad measurement, only if you allowed it when signing up.
